name: mylo-music
description: MYLO — Internet Radio, YouTube, and Local Music Super-App

scripts.build:ios:simulator: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme MYLO -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath ios/App/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO MYLO_SUPABASE_URL="${MYLO_SUPABASE_URL}" MYLO_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="${MYLO_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY}" build
scripts.archive:ios: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme MYLO -configuration Release -archivePath ios/App/build/MYLO.xcarchive MYLO_SUPABASE_URL="${MYLO_SUPABASE_URL}" MYLO_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="${MYLO_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY}" archive

author: MYLO
